meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需切换至深度工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你希望用一个模式指令来引导工作状态
copy.tagline_en: Switch into a deep work mode on demand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a directive to steer your working state

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求开启 ultrawork 模式,Claude 会先显示“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,然后为你的请求建立目标与逐条计划,并边做边记录。“先证明失败、再修到通过”是硬规矩;它还会在真实界面验证、留存证据,而不是只跑测试就算完成。
howto.when: 当你在对话里明确要求开启 ultrawork 模式(例如说“进入 ultrawork 模式”)时触发;若该指令已在本次对话中出现,则不会重复读取。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修这个 bug:先写失败证明,再修复并验证。
say.note: Claude 会按红→绿流程执行,保存证据。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,按 heavy 级别开发这个新模块。
say.note: 面对新模块会升级证据与评审流程。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork,帮我用浏览器实测这个页面改动。
say.note: 触发真实浏览器 QA 通道,留截图证据。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude first prints "ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!", then registers a goal, keeps a durable notepad, writes an ordered plan, and works failing-first (RED→GREEN). It verifies on the real surface and saves evidence instead of treating unit tests alone as proof of done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly request ultrawork mode (e.g., saying "enable ultrawork mode"). It is not reread when the directive is already in this conversation.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in ultrawork mode: show a failing proof first, then fix and verify.
say_en.note: Claude runs the red-to-green flow and saves evidence.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and build this new module at heavy tier.
say_en.note: New modules escalate the evidence and review process.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork and verify this page change in a real browser.
say_en.note: Uses the real-browser QA channel and keeps a screenshot.
